current_gate_contract: G1 source outcome provenance comes from an independent environment or evaluator rather than researcher post-labeling
G2 actionable content can be matched or canonicalized without consulting confirmatory target outcomes
G3 the intended intervention changes only the declared provenance channel; backend-only relabel is reserved as a negative control
G4 fresh target tasks are disjoint from historical R19 and the remaining legacy 27 units
G5 frozen terminal or decisive-action endpoints are replayable under the same evaluator
G6 independent task, template, or family defines statistical n; seeds and requests are nested repetitions
G7 matching, exclusion, and support decisions are outcome-blind with respect to confirmatory targets
G8 manifest, estimands, exclusions, moderators, precision or power rule, and stopping rule are frozen before first confirmatory outcome

G1.evidence: Released LLB terminal success is produced by the environment evaluator and propagated into source memory metadata.success; post-use q_value remains a separate field.

G2.evidence: R39 freezes selected IDs/order/content bytes before arm projection and exposes provenance as a separate field without consulting future target outcomes.

G3.evidence: Content-only versus truthful source_outcome_success arms are projected after identical retrieval; backend-only relabel remains an equivalence control and no retrieval rerun is allowed.

G4.evidence: MemRL OSInteraction uses a separate 150-task validation split; the historical R19/legacy cohort is ReasoningBank/BrowserGym WebArena Shopping, so target task identity is disjoint by substrate and task namespace.

G5.evidence: Native OSInteractionContainer reset/isolation/timeout/cleanup and repeated released evaluator replay pass on a fixed train support unit while validation treatment outcomes remain sealed.

G6.evidence: The inference unit is prospectively frozen as exact skill_list-signature dependency cluster; OSInteraction has 148 validation clusters versus the frozen 32-unit reference, while seeds/requests remain nested repetitions.

G7.evidence: Validation is read-only; matching/collision rules, retrieval membership, exclusions, and support requirements are frozen before arm projection and before any confirmatory outcome.
G7.source: R39.G4_fresh_capacity + R40 frozen_confirmatory_contract + R41 access accounting

G8.evidence: Scientific estimands/moderators plus the R40 randomization/exclusion/missingness/multiplicity/test/stopping rules are frozen, and a fixed image candidate has 29/29 declared validation skills. The current E0-E5 execution manifest, exact model/embedding identities, and final confirmatory runtime image binding have not yet been sealed together in one content-addressed manifest.
